data.content_ref: inline:The proposed contradiction via 'append-only monotonicity fails when artifacts can be revoked' asserts a relation between SRC_007 and SRC_006 but provides no causal mechanism: it never explains HOW revocation and re-admission of committed artifacts breaks the monotonicity assumption in a way that produces a logical contradiction between the two sources. A contradiction requires showing that a property asserted by one endpoint is necessarily false given a property of the other; the target instead asserts that a background assumption 'fails' and then abstracts an invariant, without connecting the revocation mechanism to any specific claim made by either endpoint. The 'refuted if' clause only re-asserts the append-only premise without addressing the missing causal link, so the entry is effectively a summary of an assumption plus an abstraction, not a substantive contradiction relation.
